gloss: late at night, the dead of night

definitions.gloss: late at night, the dead of night, late-night hours
definitions.explanation: The period of night well past midnight, when most people are asleep. Evokes a quiet, still atmosphere.

examples.english: I woke up in the dead of night.

examples.japanese: {夜更|よふ}け⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んでいた→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I was reading a book until late at night.

examples.japanese: {夜更|よふ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{静|しず}まり{返|かえ}って→静まり返る：14630_shizumarikaeru⟧、⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{気配|けはい}→気配：00206_kehai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧まったく⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: The city in the dead of night was completely still, with no sign of people at all.

notes:
USAGE:
A somewhat literary or evocative word for the late-night hours. More atmospheric than simply saying ⟦{深夜|しんや}→深夜：00368_shinya⟧ (late night). Often used in narrative descriptions to set a mood of quietness and solitude.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{深夜|しんや}→深夜：00368_shinya⟧: late at night (neutral, factual)
- {夜更|よふ}け: the dead of night (literary, atmospheric)
- ⟦{真夜中|まよなか}→真夜中：05425_mayonaka⟧: midnight, the middle of the night

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夜更|よふ}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in the dead of night
- {夜更|よふ}け⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: until late at night
- {夜更|よふ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧: the city late at night
